review_comments:
The entire point of `VisibilityContainer`s is that they're supposed *to manage their own visibility*. IMO doing things with `State` to manage visibility outwardly in `OsuGame` is improper.

Regardless, this logic is broken in cases in which `HideOverlaysOnEnter` is true (i.e. editor). Reproduction steps:
  
* Open game
* Go to editor
* Go back to main menu
  
The toolbar will not reappear again, even though <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>T</kbd> was never pressed.
